name: nomos
title: Nomos Constitution Vocabulary
description: Deployment constitution vocabulary for the omphalos store. This is an internal SHACL-retrofit contract, not a served vocabulary pack: it validates the authored world constitution before it is reconciled into the deployment-level omphalos graph.

nomos:identityAnchor.comment: Identity anchor strategy; v0 uses rdf-iri.

nomos:hostsGraph.comment: Graph entries hosted by this deployment.

nomos:usesOracle.comment: Optional local oracle capability exposed to agents through Garden-owned tool facades.

nomos:hasOracleBinding.comment: Graph-level oracle policy binding; exact graphId bindings override wildcard bindings.

nomos:modelId.comment: Embedding model identifier, resolved against the code catalog.

nomos:dimensions.comment: Vector dimensionality for the selected model.

Graph.comment: A graph entry hosted by the deployment.

nomos:oracleKind.comment: Stable oracle family identifier, for example kg-ultra.

nomos:serviceId.comment: Local service host id used by loopback routes.

nomos:enabled.comment: Whether this oracle is available in the local constitution.

nomos:inputLayer.comment: Garden-owned input layer consumed by the oracle facade.

nomos:outputVocab.comment: Durable Garden vocabulary pack receiving oracle testimony.

nomos:projectionTarget.comment: Garden projection target for accepted oracle testimony.

nomos:supportsTask.comment: Task descriptor supported by this oracle.

Oracle.comment: A local oracle capability such as the unified KG-ULTRA / UltraQuery surface.

nomos:taskId.comment: Stable task id selected by the Garden broker.

nomos:taskKind.comment: Task family, for example link-prediction or logical-query-answering.

nomos:modelId.comment: Underlying model identifier. Agents see the unified oracle surface, not this selector.

nomos:supportsPath.comment: Whether this task supports path-shaped logical queries.

nomos:supportsIntersection.comment: Whether this task supports conjunction/intersection query shapes.

nomos:supportsUnion.comment: Whether this task supports union query shapes.

nomos:supportsNegation.comment: Whether this task supports negated query clauses.

nomos:defaultTopK.comment: Default candidate count for this task.

nomos:defaultMinScore.comment: Default minimum oracle score for this task.

OracleTask.comment: A broker-selectable task behind an oracle.

nomos:usesOracle.comment: Oracle governed by this graph binding.

nomos:graphId.comment: Graph id this policy applies to, or * for the wildcard binding.

nomos:mode.comment: Binding mode; active is the default.

nomos:allowedTask.comment: Task ids available for this graph.

nomos:topK.comment: Maximum candidates requested from the oracle.

nomos:minScore.comment: Minimum score retained in the Garden-facing storybook.

nomos:maxHops.comment: Maximum logical path length exposed to the query broker.

nomos:allowPath.comment: Whether agents may submit path-shaped queries through the unified surface.

nomos:allowIntersection.comment: Whether agents may submit intersection-shaped queries through the unified surface.

nomos:allowUnion.comment: Whether agents may submit union-shaped queries through the unified surface.

nomos:allowNegation.comment: Whether agents may submit negated clauses; defaults false.

nomos:persistPolicy.comment: Persistence policy for oracle testimony; on-request is the default.

nomos:requiresAcceptance.comment: Whether candidate acceptance must pass through Garden wire authority.

nomos:maxPersistedCandidates.comment: Maximum candidates persisted as oracle testimony for one request.

OracleBinding.comment: Graph policy for how a Garden cell exposes an oracle to agents.

comment: Internal omphalos constitution contract. Embedded and sha-pinned for validation, deliberately absent from VOCAB_REGISTRY.
